description: FileWithIncludes declares additionalProperties=false outside allOf, while all its properties and required keys are declared only inside allOf branches. Under OpenAPI 3.0 this forbids the same fields it requires; the provider-authored file response cannot validate. MediaLinksCollection members have the same allOf/additionalProperties conflict. The node accepts and preserves the provider documented response, verified in test_current_documented_file_response; the pinned contract is unchanged.
